profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Trulioo
profile.summary:
Highly skilled full stack engineer with a passion for creating innovative software solutions. I thrive in cross-functional teams and excel in Agile development environments, where I collaborate with diverse professionals to design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software.

With a strong foundation in Computer Science and Mathematics, I have honed my skills in Java, Python, C/C++, JavaScript, and other programming languages. My expertise extends to web technologies such as HTML, CSS, ReactJS, and React Native, enabling me to build intuitive and responsive user interfaces.

Throughout my academic and professional journey, I have tackled challenging projects, such as automating manual workflows, developing file monitoring programs, and building web and mobile applications. These experiences have sharpened my problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Created a python script to completely migrate a manual workflow into an automatic process that checks for 1000+ customers’ contact information in 6 minutes and 30 seconds.
- Incorporated a Selenium package to grab HTML elements from the company’s page, Microsoft Dynamics libraries to query contact information, Google Drive API to upload output files and Slack Webhook API to send the message on Slack.

positions.title: Web Developer / Mobile App Developer
positions.description:
- Developed interactive web interfaces for several web pages using ReactJS, CSS, React Bootstrap, and MUI components.
- Constructed the landing screen and the order task screens for the rusher version of the mobile app using React Native.
- Analyzed to make sure the applications are responsive across multiple platforms and used Git for version control.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Composed own version of a file monitoring program that detects all the changes being made in the input directory such as creating, deleting, and renaming the file using C++ in Windows Operating System.
- Implemented a Dialog-based Win32 C Program that reads different inputs from the users by using multiple threads.

positions.title: Platoon Leader
positions.description:
- Trained with the Combat Arms Branch of the United States Army and served as a Human Resources Specialist for 6th Squadron 9th U.S. Cavalry and 5th Squadron 4th Cavalry Regiment.
- Nominated as a Senior KATUSA to take the leadership role of other Korean soldiers.

company.name: US 8th Army Korean Augmentation To the United States Army

projects.title: MNIST Digits Classification
projects.description:
- Utilized Machine Learning algorithms to classify handwritten digits and model each label as a multivariate Gaussian using NumPy.
- Performed relationship extraction following the NLP method to get a correct label.

projects.title: Food Classification
projects.description:
- Employed Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) using PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn to classify food images based on various descriptors.
- Achieved high validation accuracy through hyperparameter tuning.

organizations.name: KSEA (Korean American Scientists and Engineers Association)
organizations.description:
- Mentored first-year Computer Science students.
- Organized academic and social events for STEM majors.
- Helped plan courses for incoming students.
- Volunteered as proctor/grader for a National Mathematics & Science Competition (NMSC).

organizations.name: WAREP
organizations.description:
- Gave tours to prospective family and answered their questions.
- Shared experiences as an international student.
- Demonstrated leadership as a student representative.
